name: Lucky Strike
description: Bump a random main stat by 55%

name: Mystery Strike
note: The wiki only says "a mystery amount". Modelled as a uniform roll in the configured range.
description: Bump listed stat by a mystery amount.

name: Echo Devotion
description: Sacrifice one echo to enhance listed stat by 80%

name: Nurture
note: Does not consume an upgrade slot.
description: Enhance listed stat by +1 (does not consume a slot)

name: Mystify
note: Does not consume an upgrade slot.
description: Enhance listed Echo by +1 (does not consume a slot)

name: Soulbet
description: 50% to max one main stat. 50% to destroy the item.

name: Wild Reroll
note: Reroll distribution is undocumented; modelled as uniform between the line minimum and maximum.
description: Randomize the value of a random main stat.

name: Targeted Reroll
note: Reroll distribution is undocumented; modelled as uniform between the line minimum and maximum.

name: Total Reroll
note: Reroll distribution is undocumented; modelled as uniform between the line minimum and maximum.
description: Randomize the value of every main Stat.

name: Echo Trade
note: Assumed to move every stat 35% of the way back down toward its minimum, mirroring how gains close the gap upward.
description: Reduce all main stat by 35%, but add 2 random Echoes.

name: Scrap
description: Destroy the item and refund 50% of the materials.
